validated_properties: same request replays exact prior response and next token without re-execution
expired in-progress request becomes UNCERTAIN and is never automatically re-executed
previous rolling token is request-bound for resilient requests
nested parameter order canonicalizes recursively and nested secret fields are excluded from fingerprints
replay receipts contain no plaintext session id, old token or next token
session-open replay cannot roll a later token backward
critical approval status is read-only and exact-binding-sha protected
pending update inspector is read-only and hides internal package path
public source manifest status exposes hashes only, never source content
